shortDescription: Manage snapshot schedules on Unity storage system

options.name: auto_delete
options.description: Indicates whether the system can automatically delete the snapshot.

options.name: day_interval
options.description: Number of days between snapshots. Applicable only when rule type is C(every_n_days).

options.name: day_of_month
options.description: Day of the month for which the snapshot schedule rule applies. Applicable only when rule type is C(every_month). Value should be [1, 31].

options.name: days_of_week
options.description: Days of the week for which the snapshot schedule rule applies. Applicable only when rule type is C(every_week).

options.name: desired_retention
options.description: The number of days/hours for which snapshot will be retained. When I(auto_delete) is C(true), I(desired_retention) cannot be specified. Maximum desired retention supported is 31 days or 744 hours.

options.name: hour
options.description: The hour when the snapshot will be taken. Applicable for C(every_n_days), C(every_week), C(every_month) rule types. For create operation, if I(hour) parameter is not specified, value will be taken as C(0). Value should be [0, 23].

options.name: hours_of_day
options.description: Hours of the day when the snapshot will be taken. Applicable only when rule type is C(every_day).

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the snapshot schedule.

options.name: interval
options.description: Number of hours between snapshots. Applicable only when rule type is C(every_n_hours).

options.name: minute
options.description: Minute offset from the hour when the snapshot will be taken. Applicable for all rule types. For a create operation, if I(minute) parameter is not specified, value will be taken as C(0). Value should be [0, 59].

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the snapshot schedule. Name is mandatory for a create operation. Specify either I(name) or I(id) (but not both) for any operation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: retention_unit
options.description: The retention unit for the snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the snapshot schedule should exist or not.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the rule to be included in snapshot schedule. Type is mandatory for any create or modify operation. Once the snapshot schedule is created with one type it can be modified.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
